report.title: Jury report — awards public site (site-next `dist/`, five routes) — 2026-10-22

axes.name: Design (40)
axes.reason: A four-token proof-paper world held on five routes, the 404 and every browser surface, with a first viewport that is an object (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-s00.png`); kept under 8 by finish seams: the chapter 3 plate seen in flight and an empty half beside the figures (`20261022T154816-jury/desktop-s38.png`, `desktop-s46.png`), commands split mid-word, an unauthored wordmark hover, and strip frames that read as grey miniatures, worst on tablet

axes.name: Usability (30)
axes.reason: Every gesture has a key path, reduced motion keeps every state, no gate, layout shift 0 on every route and width, Install sticky at every depth and width; capped at 8 by walk step 8 (commands split inside tokens at 320, 390 and 1440), and below 768 px Docs and Recipes are reachable only from the colophon at the foot of each route

axes.name: Creativity (20)
axes.reason: The page argues its claim by being its own proof sheet: its captured frames track the reader's depth and chapter 3 grows its own s00 beside its own measured figures; the scroll-synced thumbnail column is a known minimap move, and the judging half of the thesis (the marks) cannot show until this report exists

axes.name: Content (10)
axes.reason: Every count checked against the plugin holds (89 rules as 8/5/8/18/10/9/10/21, 62 cards, 55 skeletons, 26 patterns, 89 recipes, 76 passes, 11 skills), two registers, credits with licences and an authored 404; but the lede and chapter 4's heading say 89 rules run after every edit while chapter 4's own body and `hooks/hooks.json:32` say a fast subset does, and the ship rule is printed two different ways on home and /docs

axes.name: Weighted
axes.reason: SOTD threshold ≥ 7.2 with no axis < 6.8: met

developer.name: Semantics / SEO
developer.reason: A title, description, canonical and Open Graph text per route, one h1, landmarks, `lang`, skip link, an ARIA tree that reads in order (`home/desktop-aria.yml`); the canonical is relative (`./`) and `og:image` is relative with no `og:url` (`index.html:29`, `:40`), the baseline's floor fix 5 carried over

developer.name: Animations / Transitions
developer.reason: One GSAP ticker drives Lenis, the strip (damped with a clamped dt) and one paused master timeline on `ease: none`; transforms only, `will-change` only on the plate in flight (`src/styles/site.css:332`), View Transitions with a reduced opt-out; the chapter 3 hold is `vh × 0.15` (`src/motion/loupe.js:32`), so the scrubbed plate rarely rests

developer.name: Accessibility
developer.reason: Skip link first, roving tabindex on the strip, native modal dialog with focus return, Escape on the phone disclosure, a refused clipboard said on the ticket and in `role=status`, 44 px targets (A18 clean), axe-core 0 violations, focus ring 18:1 on both surfaces; strip links are named for the picture, not the chapter they jump to

developer.name: WPO
developer.reason: Entry JS 59.6 KB gz (158.7 KB raw), CSS 7.0 KB gz, three preloaded woff2 (58 KB), WebP frames lazy except s00/s25, layout shift 0 and blocking ≤ 12 ms on every route; throttled LCP unmeasured, and /recipes' `lcpColdSynthetic` of 3.4–4.1 s is read only as the weight of its 99 lazy images

developer.name: Responsive Design
developer.reason: Three designed layouts (25 % strip, 22 % strip with the nav two by two, a 56 px band with inline chapter frames), `clamp()` from 1440, hover states only under `(hover: hover)`, no overflow at 320 px; commands split inside tokens at every width, and the phone band drops Docs and Recipes

developer.name: Markup / Meta-data
developer.reason: No duplicate ids on any route, theme-color, colour-scheme, an SVG favicon, 0 console and page errors; `og.png` is still the pre-capture drawing that `DESIGN.md ## Browser surfaces` says the proof step replaces once a capture exists, and every manifest records `buildDirty: true`

report.target: Target line (Awwwards, the rubric's thresholds as they stand): `Awwwards: SOTD candidate`. A weighted 7.70 with the lowest axis at 7.5 clears 7.2 / 6.8. The gap to the stronger winners is Design: 7.5 sits just under the corpus median of 7.63, and what holds it there is imagery that is this page's own screenshots at thumbnail size plus the finish seams in the craft list. The rubric runs about 0.7 under the published award by design; this target line moves no score.

report.keep: The rail of this page's own frames following the reader at the depth being read, beside the red-ringed install ticket on bare proof paper (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-s00.png`, `20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-s50.png`): fix the plate's hold, the breaks and the copy around it; never shrink, recolour or decorate the strip, and never add a second red.

walks.line: - walk 1 — pass — skip link first on Tab (`20261022T155633-jury-states/skip/desktop-state-skip-link.png`), Enter then Tab lands on the first Copy (`20261022T155633-jury-states/skip/desktop-state-skip-enter.png`); a ring on every control in the world's two inks (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-focus-1.png` to `-3`); strip arrows and Enter (`20261022T153931Z-prejury-states/keys-desktop-state-strip-rove.png`, `keys-desktop-state-strip-jump.png`); dialog Escape returns focus (`keys-desktop-state-loupe-closed.png`); phone Frames Escape returns focus (`phone-mobile-state-frames-escape.png`); recipe filter by keyboard (`20261022T155633-jury-states/filter/recipes-html/desktop-state-filter-tag-keys.png`, 1 of 89 shown)

- walk 2 — pass — no cursor or magnetic effects; strip hover and the Copy fill only under `(hover: hover)`, so a tap leaves paper behind (`20261022T153931Z-prejury-states/phone-mobile-state-copy-tap-after.png`); targets 44 px (A18 clean at three widths); the recipe rail is native overflow with snap; below 768 px Docs and Recipes leave the band and head the colophon only (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/mobile-s00.png` vs `mobile-s100.png`), friction rather than a missing equivalent

- walk 3 — pass — reduced frames readable at rest on every route (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-rm-s00.png` to `s100`), rings printed, the plate placed at its box with no growth (`20261022T154816-jury/desktop-rm-s38.png`), strip jump, dialog, copy and filter all work reduced (`keys-desktop-rm-state-*`), no global kill (`src/motion/index.js` tiers)
- walk 4 — pass — no preloader, text paints first, layout shift 0 on every route and width, longest blocking 12 ms (/recipes phone)

- walk 5 — pass — s00 alone says what (a plugin for Claude Code and Codex that holds a site to a written contract), who (people running those clients) and what to do (two commands with Copy, ringed) (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-s00.png`)

- walk 6 — pass — the current route underlined in the rebate (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/docs-html/desktop-s00.png`), the current strip frame is the depth cue (`home/desktop-s50.png`), the wordmark goes home, the 404 offers three ways out (`404-html/desktop-s00.png`); on the phone each chapter head's frame carries its stop (`20261022T155047-jury-phone/mobile-s10.png`, `mobile-s60.png`)

- walk 7 — pass — one action matched to the stakes (two commands, free, reversible), Install in the rebate at every depth and width (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/home/desktop-s50.png`, `home/mobile-s50.png`), the select again at the close (`20261022T154816-jury/desktop-s88.png`); "Install it" names the outcome

- walk 8 — fail — no overflow at 320 px, but `overflow-wrap: anywhere` (`src/styles/base.css:65`) splits commands and paths inside tokens: the primary command reads `burgisimon/awar` / `ds` at 320 (`20261022T155633-jury-states/w320/home/mobile-s00.png`), `doctor.mj` / `s` and `--` / `with-deps` at 390 (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/install-html/mobile-s50.png`), `scripts/doctor.m` / `js` at 1440 (`20261022T153705Z-prejury-2/docs-html/desktop-s75.png`); caps Usability at 8

report.ceiling: Ceiling: the editor's china-marker crop brackets, the L-corners that choose which part of a frame gets enlarged, never appear, so chapter 3's enlargement arrives without the mark that on a real contact sheet orders it.
